utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Oren, do you have any idea what tools we're missing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, I brought my tools and some snacks for Saturday, but I can't recall exactly what I have.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Let's go check your car, then I can start a list of what we have.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Hana, did you hear the repair drive is this Saturday? I heard Quinn has the full list of supplies.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Is Quinn the one coordinating the supplies? I want to make sure I'm not missing anything.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, Quinn's got the master list, but Rosa sent me a copy if you need to check.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I've checked the inventory twice, so we're all set for the repairs.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, the repair drive is this Saturday, right? Just double-checking.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, it's this Saturday. I've made sure we have everything ready.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Just a reminder, the repair drive is still set for Saturday. I've checked the inventory and we have plenty of parts.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I'm late, Opal. I've got that old laptop I promised to bring for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, that'll be useful. I'll add it to the list.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Eli, just confirming the repair drive is this Saturday at the community center. I'll bring snacks as planned.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That's right, Saturday. I'll have my coffee maker ready to fix.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, glad you're on board. Do you need any tools or parts for that coffee maker?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Sam, are you coming to the repair drive on Saturday? Vik's bringing his toaster, and I'm bringing my blender.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yeah, I'll be there! I can help sort through everyone's donated tools and gadgets.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh great! And Noah's bringing his old radio, and Eli's bringing his coffee maker too. Should be a fun day fixing things up.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Noah, did you hear about the repair drive this Saturday? You should come!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, yeah, the repair drive! I think I remember hearing about that. What time does it start?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It starts at 10 AM at the community center. Are you in?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, so we've got a laptop, coffee maker, blender, and toaster coming in.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great. Let's meet at 9am Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: 9am Saturday, got it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I'm so glad you're interested in the repair drive! We're all set for Sunday at the community center—could you help with greeting folks at the door?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Actually, Rosa, I thought the repair drive is on Saturday, not Sunday. And I'm happy to help, but I'm better at managing supplies than greeting at the door.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, I double-checked the schedule, and it's definitely Sunday. And managing supplies would be perfect—thank you, Cleo!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Mara, are you coming to the repair drive on Saturday? Sam's helping, and Oren and Dane are pitching in too.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yeah, I'll be there! Glad Oren's bringing his tools — we'll need 'em.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, and Dane's hauling in an old laptop to donate — should be fun!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Uli, just reminding you the repair drive is still on Saturday. I'm bringing my toaster, and Eli's bringing his coffee maker, Jules her blender, and Rey has supplies ready.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'll see if I have any spare parts around the house.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, spare parts would be super helpful! So, just to recap, the drive is Saturday—I've got my toaster, Eli's coffee maker, Jules' blender, and Rey's supplies.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: The repair drive is on Saturday, right?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yes, it's Saturday at the community center. I'm helping Eli sort the tools there.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I'll bring the supplies then.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Ira, the repair drive is this Saturday! Sam's helping out and Oren brought some tools.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh great, I'll be helping Eli sort tools—see you there!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: And Dane's bringing an old laptop to donate—should be a good event!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I have some spare parts in my garage, but I need to check if they're any good.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, that's great! We could always use extra parts. I've already inventoried plenty, but bring them anyway—better safe than sorry. The drive is Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'll see what I can find. Saturday it is.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Eli, just a reminder—the repair drive is this Sunday at the community center. Think you can lend a hand?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Wait, Rosa—I thought the repair drive was this Saturday, not Sunday. I've got my coffee maker ready for it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, I'm sorry for the confusion, Eli—it's definitely Sunday. I promise we'll have a spot for that coffee maker.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive is on Saturday. Do you know what to bring?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, I remember! Rey's bringing supplies, Oren has the tools, and Eli's bringing his coffee maker.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I think Vik and Tess are both bringing toasters, and Quinn has the full list of supplies.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Dane, you got your old laptop for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I finally dug it out of the closet. It's old but should still work for parts.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, so we've got laptops, toasters, blenders, coffee makers—sounds like a real tech yard sale in the making.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive is this Saturday! I'll bring my tools and some snacks.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, Oren! I've got the supply list ready, and I'll share it with everyone.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, let me know if I should add my tools to that list!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Gus, just making sure we're all set for the repair drive on Saturday. I've got the supply list ready.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Cleo, I think the drive is actually on Sunday, not Saturday. But no worries—I've got my wrenches and screwdrivers ready to go.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, I'm pretty sure it's Saturday, Gus. I have it marked on my calendar.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, Dane brought an old laptop. I've been sorting tools for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Saturday works. I'll carry supplies.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, I'll also bring some extra screwdrivers I have.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Leo! I'm bringing snacks for the repair drive on Saturday. Are you able to help with anything?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I'll bring a toolbox. See you Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks Leo! The drive is at the community center, starting at 10.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I'm bringing my toaster to the repair drive on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Wait, I thought only Oren and Eli were bringing items. Can you double-check that?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No, let me remind you: Eli's bringing his coffee maker, Jules is bringing her blender, and Rey has the supplies. So it's not just Oren and me.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the repair drive is on Saturday. I almost forgot.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, are you sure it's Saturday? I thought it was.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, definitely Saturday. I wrote it down and everything.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Should I start listing what tools we're missing or do you want to handle that?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can take care of that, Mina. Let me grab my list.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Alright, then. I'll start checking what we already have.
